description: This file defines the ServerSettings interface and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing server configuration options in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: instanceOfServerSettings
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the ServerSettings interface.

methods.description: Creates a ServerSettings object from a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates a ServerSettings object from a JSON object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.description: Serializes a ServerSettings object to JSON.
